verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party, real-time, bidirectional ERP sync. The only accounting-related item is an Embedded Payroll API endpoint that generates a General Ledger report as JSON on request. That is a one-way developer building block a builder would need to wire into an ERP, not a native sync that replaces manual journal entries. Webhooks are also generic developer infrastructure rather than an ERP integration, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can rely on real-time bidirectional sync with my ERP instead of manual journal entries

citations.quote: When you create a General Ledger report and use the resulting request_uuid to retrieve the report, you'll see that the report is generated in a JSON format.
